scope: Image layout, gross scene alignment and measured quality/resource curves; not paper-number reproduction or method efficacy.
formal_observations: Final cam00 frame299 aligns with the table, window, shelves and person; no blank render or gross camera displacement. Fine texture and dynamic torso/hand regions remain imperfect. Formal300 quality curves remain finite and stable.
development_limitations: Both sparse-init dev views contain background/edge coverage errors. cut_roasted_beef PSNR declines in later dev frames; initialization, changing content and inherited motion/offset behavior have not been causally separated. Do not treat these runs as paper-quality replication or claim mixture gains from initialization differences.
layout: Ground truth, prediction and error panels are readable; color scales, axes and legends are visible.
